entities.name: Zagorka
entities.description: Elderly human woman of Otaria who became leader of the refugees in Sanctum and was accidentally killed by Kamahl.

entities.name: Ixidor
entities.description: Wizard of Aphetto against whom the Nightmare War was fought.

entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: Fighter who killed Akroma, Phage and accidentally Zagorka.

entities.name: Akroma
entities.description: Combatant in the final battle with Phage, killed by Kamahl.

entities.name: Phage
entities.description: Combatant in the final battle with Akroma, killed by Kamahl.

entities.name: Sanctum
entities.description: Abandoned city on the Corian Escarpment where refugees found asylum; it was the Numena Averru.

entities.name: Averru
entities.description: Numena who was the city of Sanctum and regarded Zagorka as his mother.

entities.name: Nightmare War
entities.description: War against the wizard Ixidor in Aphetto.

entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: Place on Dominaria where Zagorka lived.

events.summary: Zagorka flees the overwhelming Nightmare War and finds refuge in the abandoned city of Sanctum.
events.quote: she fled when the battle became overwhelming

events.summary: Kamahl kills Akroma and Phage and accidentally Zagorka.
events.quote: Kamahl killed them both and (accidentally) Zagorka as well

relations.quote: Kamahl killed them both and (accidentally) Zagorka as well
